summary: HealthSpace appears to expose active/current Northern Health water notices with start dates, but not a clean public archive of lifted/resolved notices. Historical notices can be partially reconstructed from municipal/news pages, but those are fragmented by community and source.

what_it_contains: Current active Boil Water Notices and Water Quality Advisories
Underlying problems / remedy / corrective actions when present
what_it_does_not_appear_to_contain: A separate public resolved/lifted notice archive
Historical notice timeline per facility beyond the current active notice state

local_parser_update.change: Start-date parsing now also checks nearby h6 siblings when the page structure places Start date after the notice details block.
local_parser_update.blocked_refetch_note: A direct refetch attempt on 2026-05-10 returned HTTP 403 from HealthSpace, so the local active notices JSON still needs to be refreshed when HealthSpace allows access.

other_sources.coverage: Resolved/lifted Prince Rupert notices with issue/rescind context
other_sources.notes: Useful for Prince Rupert historical notices, but not a Northern Health-wide source.

other_sources.coverage: Issued and lifted Kitimat water quality advisories
other_sources.notes: Good local historical source for Kitimat, including PDFs.

other_sources.coverage: Individual lifted/rescinded advisories reported by community
other_sources.notes: Useful for evidence but incomplete and inconsistent for a dataset.

recommended_next_step: Refresh HealthSpace active notices after the parser adjustment to populate start_date for active notices. Treat full historical/resolved notices as a separate research/scrape project using municipal websites and news archives by community.
